name: Aider
tagline: Terminal-based AI pair programming tool that edits local git repositories directly using local or cloud LLMs.
real_test_summary: Tested running multi-file code refactors inside a local Git repository connected to an Ollama endpoint. Automatically maps repository structure and creates clean git commits per change.
pros: Automatic git commits with descriptive messages for every AI edit
Repository map tracks cross-file dependencies without manual file tagging
Works cleanly in any terminal alongside existing editors
cons: Command-line workflow has a steeper learning curve than GUI editors
Smaller local models under 14B parameters can struggle with strict diff formats
